description: blueteam-fabric's rules for fabric-pr arm. The repository is the operator of agent-fabric (ADR-045 §8, docs/split/move-plan.md): BlueTeam OÜ's agents, keys, role definitions, policies, routing and distilled knowledge, read by the engine through roots. It has no build. boundary.paths: every policy under policies/ and the routing that picks and gates the review model (routing/policies/), every project's arm rules (projects/<id>/integration/gh/arm.json), as agent-fabric's own boundary has them, the agent keys and the recovery key (identities/keys/, identities/recovery.asc), the harness wiring (.claude/, .mcp.json), CI (.github/), an environment file at any depth (.env*), a certificate or key file (*.pem), and the words secret, credential and token anywhere. boundary.exempt is dropped first, but never under .claude/, .github/, policies/, routing/policies/ or identities/keys/: Markdown, which is the charters, briefs, records and slices, and .agent-fabric/. No classes. waiver_role is null: only the owner waives the boundary. No direct-to-main rule: every change is a pull request. Written 2026-11-12, at registration (j766).
